annotations.title: Clear messages from a track's Inbox

description: Removes messages from the track's Inbox that will never be rows, like newsletters or one-off mails, so check_tracks stops counting them. This can't be undone, so first list for the person what you'd clear (sender and subject) and clear only what they agree to; in a scheduled or unattended run, only report them. Give each as read_inbox listed it (row, time, subject). Don't clear a message a hack should read: add a hack instead.
name: dismiss_inbox
title: Clear messages from a track's Inbox
